forja.help.title: The Forge
forja.help.intro: The Forge turns your merged pull requests in Tolkien into a character sheet, a private journey, and a monthly arena. The calculation is deterministic and does not use AI.
forja.help.first.title: Getting started
forja.help.first.step1: Expand The Forge from its row at the bottom of the sidebar. The console remembers whether you left it open or closed.
forja.help.first.step2: If you are not participating yet, choose ‘Forge your character sheet’. Enter your GitHub @username; we verify it and save its canonical capitalization.
forja.help.first.step3: Switch to Arena to see the podium and missions for the current season.
forja.help.festejos.title: Merge and production celebrations
forja.help.festejos.text: The Forge privately celebrates two milestones: when your PR is merged and when that ring reaches a successful production deploy. One deploy groups all your included PRs. The overlay appears on mobile even while the drawer is closed; it closes after 12 seconds unless you interact with it, and any close marks it as seen.

forja.help.legend.trophy.name: Trophy
forja.help.legend.trophy.desc: a forged achievement or a goal in progress
forja.help.legend.arena.name: Arena
forja.help.legend.arena.desc: monthly ranking based on rings from the season
forja.help.legend.private.name: Private
forja.help.legend.private.desc: your PR titles and details only appear in your hall
forja.help.actions.title: Buttons and actions
forja.help.actions.enter.v: Opens your private hall. It does not use tokens.
forja.help.actions.tabs.v: Switches between your private journey and the season's public metrics. It does not use tokens.
forja.help.actions.configure.v: Verifies that your @username exists on GitHub, saves its canonical login without changing your name, email, or signature, then requests a refresh. It does not use tokens.
forja.help.privacy.title: Keep in mind
forja.help.privacy.text: Participation is optional. The Arena shares your display name, initials, and aggregate metrics; it never publishes your login, PR titles, or URLs. If you see ‘data from…’, you are viewing the last good snapshot while GitHub recovers.
